subject.title: fix(whatsapp): normalize hosted JIDs consistently with Baileys

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed fail-closed upgrade policy for existing WhatsApp LID-form `allowFrom` and `groupAllowFrom` entries when a unique verified E.164 mapping is unavailable?
rationale: This is an intentional authorization-boundary and upgrade-policy choice: preserving legacy LID authorization can be unsafe or ambiguous, while failing closed can stop a previously working operator path until manual repair.

options.title: Approve verified-only migration
options.body: Merge the doctor migration that rewrites only uniquely verified LID mappings and leaves unresolved entries unauthorized with a visible repair warning.

options.title: Preserve legacy authorization temporarily
options.body: Keep existing LID allowlist entries valid through a separately designed compatibility policy, with an explicit deprecation and migration plan.

recommendation.title: Approve verified-only migration
recommendation.body: Merge the doctor migration that rewrites only uniquely verified LID mappings and leaves unresolved entries unauthorized with a visible repair warning.
